name: Sliced Baked Potatoes
description: A simple yet elegant baked potato dish featuring thinly sliced potatoes topped with melted cheddar and Parmesan cheese, and fresh herbs.
recipeIngredient: 2-3 Tbsp fresh chopped herbs (such as parsley, chives, thyme, or sage)

recipeInstructions.text: Scrub and rinse the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes crosswise into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use the handle of a wooden spoon on either side of the potato to guide the knife.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and fan them slightly.
Drizzle the potatoes with melted butter and sprinkle with fresh herbs.
Bake at 425°F for about 50 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheddar and Parmesan cheese and return to the oven until the cheese is lightly browned and the potatoes are soft inside.

keywords: baked potatoes, sliced potatoes, cheesy potatoes, herbed potatoes

_similar.name: Swedish Potatoes
_similar.description: A creamy mashed potato casserole topped with a buttery breadcrumb and cheese crust, serving 10 to 12 people.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp onion salt or chopped onion

recipeInstructions.text: Cook and mash the potatoes.
Mix in the remaining ingredients except for the bread crumbs, additional butter, and grated cheese.
Put the mashed potato mixture into a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Dot the top with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake, covered, at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the bread crumbs on top and return to the oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
To reheat, cover with foil (shiny side in) and heat slowly at 250°F to 300°F.

_similar.keywords: mashed potato casserole, Swedish potatoes, cheesy potato bake

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Baked Cauliflower
_similar.description: A creamy baked cauliflower casserole with cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cauliflower in boiling water and salt for 10 minutes.
In a casserole dish, stir together undiluted soup, cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Add cauliflower and mix well.
Toss bread crumbs in melted butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 250°F until bubbly.

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food
